say:0:1012302101:0.text: The blue butterflies are messengers of Misarte. Their appearance represents tranquility and freedom!
say:0:1012302101:0.source_cn: 蓝色闪蝶是弥萨忒的信使，蓝色闪蝶出现，代表宁静，和自由！

say:1:1012302102:0.text: But where did these black butterflies come from? I've never seen them in the Dark Forest!
say:1:1012302102:0.source_cn: 但黑色蝴蝶是哪里来的……我从来没在薄暮丛林见过它们！

say:2:1012302103:0.text: I've never seen them either. Even in the lands to which I've traveled, none look like these.
say:2:1012302103:0.source_cn: 我也从未见过，在外游学时，我偶尔也能见到一些蝴蝶。

say:3:1012302104:0.text: I hope their appearance isn't a bad omen.
say:3:1012302104:0.source_cn: 但这些……不一样。希望它们的出现不是不祥之兆。
